repo.description:
### Impact

On sites using Discourse AI, a moderator who was not a participant in a private message could access its content when Discourse AI created a reviewable associated with that message.

The affected reviewable could appear in the moderator's review queue and expose the private message content. Depending on the reviewable action, the moderator could also modify the private message, including closing the topic or deleting a post.

Exploitation requires an authenticated moderator account and a pre-existing Discourse AI reviewable associated with a private message.

### Patches
Upgrade to the patched version.

### Workarounds
Upgrade to the patched version.
repo.summary: Non-participant moderators can read, edit, and delete PM content through Discourse AI reviewables
